title: Before/after season Mirror state on geospatial features
hypothesis: A small factorized pre-observation and post-observation Mirror state over one Prithvi/AnySat backbone recovers useful change functions across seasonal and geographic shifts.
physical_object: one shared Prithvi-EO-2.0 or AnySat temporal backbone
mirror_coordinate: factorized pre-observation m_pre and post-observation m_post
logical_multiplicity: temporal change task functions across observations
controls: native temporal backbone plus binary change head
matched-byte FiLM/gate on the same shared features
independent per-observation/head upper control if feasible
blocker: Available OSCD_MSI metadata does not establish acquisition seasons/years needed by the registered seasonal claim; the documented Prithvi config uses four frames while OSCD pairs contain two dates, and adapting the input would change the registered comparison. CPU-only environment further limits practical backbone training/inference, but was not the primary blocker.
boundaries: This is a reproducibility/data-interface blocker, not a negative result about Mirror.
Do not infer change quality, seasonal generalization, storage, or runtime.
